title: AAPL Long — Breakout from Consolidation
summary: Entered a long position on AAPL following a confirmed breakout above the $218 resistance level with strong volume confirmation.
content:
## Setup & Thesis

Apple has been consolidating between $212 and $218 for three weeks. Today's open gapped above the range on above-average volume, confirming the breakout.

### Entry Criteria

- Price above 21-day EMA
- Volume > 1.5x 30-day average
- RSI breaking out of neutral zone (50-55 → 60+)

## Risk Management

Stop placed at $215.80 (below the prior resistance level, now support). Position sized at 2% max risk.

## Result

Target hit at $224.10. Partial exit at $221 for risk management, letting the runner go. Net PnL: **+$5.65/share**.
